# =============================================================================
# uv override for the checkov lockfile (.github/requirements.txt)
# =============================================================================
# checkov hard-pins asteval==1.0.6 in every 3.3.x release (3.3.16 through
# 3.3.19, the latest), and two advisories in asteval < 1.0.9 are reachable only
# through that pin: GHSA-89v8-rhwq-hf77 and GHSA-9w56-46f6-3qhx. Because the
# lockfile is hash-pinned, the bump is otherwise unresolvable and the two
# advisories have to sit in .github/osv-scanner.toml as accepted risk.
#
# Forcing the fixed version keeps the lockfile honest instead of ignoring the
# advisory. Consume it when compiling:
#
#   uv pip compile --generate-hashes --python-version 3.11 \
#     --overrides .github/asteval-override.txt -o /tmp/req-checkov.txt -
#
# and install the result without re-resolving (see .github/workflows/
# security.yml), otherwise pip rejects the set as unsatisfiable:
#
#   python -m pip install --no-deps --require-hashes -r .github/requirements.txt
#
# Re-evaluate when checkov adopts asteval >= 1.0.9: drop this file, drop
# --no-deps, and delete the two asteval IgnoredVulns entries for good.
# =============================================================================

asteval==1.0.9
